## Why

`classify.py` assigned bare `MET-DIFFERENTLY` — routed to `accepted` — to
evidence-free `CHART`/`ENG`/`EPIS`/`SEC`/`PUB` requirements whose notes were the
"charter/process/epistemic/publication-safety principle satisfied by design"
boilerplate: a classifier default, not a row-by-row read (F2b §4). The HG-14 bulk
acceptance of 2026-09-08 is not evidence and is not carried forward. This row
re-reads each requirement and assigns exactly one ADR-150 verdict with real
evidence, each change written as a `coverage-assessment/1` event.

## Comparison with F2b (labelled, not a target)

F2b's 13-row sample estimated ≈ 54 % not met. The full re-verdict lands at
**11 of 62 PARTIAL (≈ 18 %), 0 MISSING** — the sample overstated the share but
was directionally right: the blanket verdict did conceal real incompleteness,
now surfaced with named open homes.
